profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at AutoNation
profile.summary: Experienced Senior Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in HR/Payroll, Logistic, and Non-Banking Financial industries. Skilled in SQL Server and Oracle Databases systems, Business Intelligence (SSRS & SSIS),  Web and Desktop applications. Strong business development professional with a BS focused in Computer Sciences from University of Havana.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Member of the Corporate Applications team.  Responsible for providing solutions and support to several corporate departments as Human Resources, Payroll, Benefits, Retirement Plans, Compensation, Financial, People Development and Legal, by designing, developing and deploying services, applications, reports and backend processes.
Database and Business Intelligence developer in Oracle & SQL Server database systems using SSDT, SSIS, SSRS (SQL, T-SQL, PL/SQL), including data integration with internal and packaged applications, and other external vendors.
Web, Windows, and Office Applications development using the following technologies and languages: MS Visual Studio, .NET, ASP.NET, C#, VB, JavaScript, VBScript, HTML, XML.
Maintenance and support of my own built applications and other legacy systems.
Data Research, Analysis and Ad hoc reports for end-users.

positions.title: Senior Programmer
positions.description: Development of Custom Document Imaging software for Life insurance and financial documents. Coded in C# and SQL Server.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Database, Web and Windows Development, EDI

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description: Database development, migrating all the software backend from FoxPro to SQL Server.

positions.title: IT Consultant
positions.description: Managed all the IT related activities in the Latin America Headquarter. Coordinating other activities with Global HQ IT Department. Maintenaning all the systems and reports for HQ users. Supported infrastructure, including Phone, Network, Servers, and programming devices in the Latin America HQ. Supervisor of production line.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Architecture, Development, ad support of Windows and Web based application developed in Delphi and C#. Database development in Paradox, Interbase and SQL Server systems.
